text.description_html:
Bommer 15019-626, Satin Chrome Restroom Bolt with Occupancy Indicator

The Lavatory Rim Bolt and Keeper with Occupancy Indicator is for use on commercial bathroom doors and stalls. The occupancy indicator on the outside that reads either "Vacant" with a green background or "Occupied" with a red background. The bolt is thrown and retracted by rotating the knob.

Features and Specifications of the Bathroom Stall Lock with Vacancy Indicator:

  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Bolt Width: 2.53"
  • Bolt Length: 2.72"
  • Bolt Throw: .312"
  • Bolt Knob Projection: .850"
  • Occupancy Indicator Diameter: 2.81"
  • Emergency keyhole release.
  • Bommer 15019/15016 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually
